Badminton Betting Odds Across Five Events

Badminton betting odds for the BWF World Tour, the World Championships and the season-ending World Tour Finals are compared on this page, with the top price on both players or pairs in every match. Singles and doubles sit side by side, and each match page adds handicap and total points prices, the line's movement and the players' past meetings.

Badminton Odds Today: One Tour, Five Events

Badminton is on the betting menu almost all year, because the World Tour moves from one host city to the next nearly every week. Each tournament has five events: men's singles, women's singles, men's doubles, women's doubles and mixed doubles, so the early rounds bring a long list of matches. Badminton odds today are listed in start order, converted to your time
